subject: sliderInput is hard to use on a draggable flixedPanel, depending on where the panel is.

messages.author: c5790e857463cacd
messages.subject: sliderInput is hard to use on a draggable flixedPanel, depending on where the panel is.
parts:
I am working on an app that plots points on a leaflet map. So far everything works well, but I would like to add a slider which helps control the radius of the points. I am using the shiny-leaflet library by Joe Cheng and his "SuperZip" example as a model. The points on the map are really circles added using map$addCircle and the slider is to help control the radius argument.  

I put the sliderInput on a fixed panel that is draggable (similar to the one on SuperZip). However there is an issue. If I drag the panel to the left side of the display everything works great. If I drag it to the right side, it is nearly impossible to use the slider. I cannot "grag" the slider tool, and if I do, moving the hand a long way only moves the slider one notch. If I put the panel in the middle of the display, then it works, but poorly. You can grab the slider tool, but to go select the right most value (my slider is 1 to 4)   you need to move the hand all the way to the right of the display, which is far past the end of the slider.

If I get time I will try to make a reproducible version and log it as an issue on github, but I am hoping someone here has a work around or at least a theory as to what the problem is.

JP
